# Prepare data

## Build fine-grained reference labels for the Bone Marrow single-cell reference

```{r}
cd_bm <- as.data.frame(colData(dat_aml_bm))

cd_bm$fine_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type) & cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type %in% aml_like_types ~
    as.character(cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type),
  TRUE ~ as.character(cd_bm$cell_type)
)

colData(dat_aml_bm)$fine_label <- cd_bm$fine_label

table(dat_aml_bm$fine_label, useNA = "ifany")
```

# CIBERSORTx

## Procedure on the web portal

### Bulk mixture files

```{r}
gene_map_bm <- as.data.frame(rowData(dat_aml_bm)) %>%
  select(ensembl_id = 1, gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct()

gene_map_bm <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id  = rownames(dat_aml_bm),
  gene_symbol = rowData(dat_aml_bm)$gene_symbol,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% distinct()

gene_map <- (gene_map_bm) %>%
  distinct(ensembl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)

cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(dge_red$counts, log = FALSE)

symbol_map <- gene_map[match(rownames(cpm_mat), gene_map$ensembl_id), "gene_symbol"]
cpm_df <- as.data.frame(cpm_mat) %>%
  mutate(GeneSymbol = symbol_map) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol)) %>%
  group_by(GeneSymbol) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>% as.data.frame()

bm_samples <- dge_red$samples$OriginalSampleName

write.table(cpm_df[, c("GeneSymbol", bm_samples)],
            file.path(params$table_dir, "mixture_BM.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Single-cell reference files

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Matrix)

export_sc_reference <- function(sce, label_col, gene_map, out_path, max_cells_per_class = 100) {
  counts_mat <- assay(sce, "counts")
  labels <- colData(sce)[[label_col]]

  set.seed(1)
  keep_idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_along(labels), labels), function(idx) {
    sample(idx, size = min(length(idx), max_cells_per_class))
  }))
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[, keep_idx]
  labels <- as.character(labels[keep_idx])

  symbol_map <- gene_map$gene_symbol[match(rownames(counts_mat), gene_map$ensembl_id)]
  keep_genes <- !is.na(symbol_map)
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[keep_genes, ]
  symbol_map <- symbol_map[keep_genes]

  dense <- as.matrix(counts_mat)
  collapsed <- rowsum(dense, group = symbol_map)
  colnames(collapsed) <- labels

  out <- data.frame(GeneSymbol = rownames(collapsed), collapsed,
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  write.table(out, out_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}

export_sc_reference(dat_aml_bm, "fine_label", gene_map,
                    file.path(params$table_dir, "reference_BM.txt"))
```
